nodes.description: Owner address of the Owned contract; set in constructor and changed by acceptOwnership.
Pending new owner address, written by transferOwnership and consumed by acceptOwnership.
mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) of ERC20 allowances.
SafeMath.safeAdd(uint a, uint b): c = a + b with require(c >= a).
SafeMath.safeSub(uint a, uint b): require(b <= a); c = a - b.
SafeMath.safeMul(uint a, uint b): c = a * b with require(a == 0 || c / a == b).
SafeMath.safeDiv(uint a, uint b): require(b > 0); c = a / b.
transferOwnership(address _newOwner) guarded by onlyOwner; writes newOwner.
acceptOwnership(): requires msg.sender == newOwner, then owner = newOwner and newOwner = address(0).
Sleipnir() constructor: sets symbol, name, decimals, total supply and pre-mints balances to deployer address.
transfer(address to, uint tokens): debits msg.sender, credits to using safeSub/safeAdd, emits Transfer.
approve(address spender, uint tokens): writes allowed[msg.sender][spender], emits Approval.
transferFrom(address from, address to, uint tokens): moves balances and decrements allowed[from][msg.sender] without an explicit allowance sufficiency check.
allowance(address tokenOwner, address spender): returns allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
approveAndCall(address spender, uint tokens, bytes data): sets allowance then calls ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(...).
transferAnyERC20Token(address tokenAddress, uint tokens) onlyOwner: external call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens).
msg.sender: caller-controlled address used for ownership, balance debits and allowance indexing.
External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(msg.sender, tokens, this, data) executed while an allowance to spender is already set.
External call to an arbitrary ERC20Interface contract at tokenAddress transferring its tokens to owner.
Integer multiplication c = a * b inside safeMul (overflow-guarded by require(a == 0 || c / a == b)).
Parameter spender of approveAndCall; also the callback target address.
Parameter data of approveAndCall, forwarded to the external receiveApproval call.
Parameter tokenAddress of transferAnyERC20Token; attacker-influenced external contract address.

edges.reason: msg.sender is permanently assigned as owner in the Owned constructor, anchoring all ownership-based access control.
onlyOwner modifier requires msg.sender == owner before transferOwnership state changes.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner before transferring ownership.
msg.sender identifies the account whose balances entry is debited in transfer.
msg.sender indexes allowed[msg.sender][spender] in approve.
msg.sender identifies the spender whose allowance is decremented in transferFrom.
msg.sender is the allowance owner and is forwarded to the external receiveApproval callback.
Owned constructor writes the owner state variable.
transferOwnership writes the pending newOwner state variable.
acceptOwnership reads newOwner to validate the caller.
acceptOwnership overwrites owner with newOwner and clears newOwner.
Sleipnir constructor sets the symbol.
Sleipnir constructor sets the name.
Sleipnir constructor sets the decimals.
Sleipnir constructor sets _totalSupply to 1000000000000.
Sleipnir constructor pre-mints the full supply into balances of the deployer address.
totalSupply reads _totalSupply.
totalSupply reads balances[address(0)] to subtract burned tokens.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping.
allowance reads the allowed mapping.
transfer reads and writes both the sender and recipient balances entries.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender].
transferFrom mutates balances[from] and balances[to] on behalf of another account without any authorization check beyond the implicit allowance decrement.
transferFrom spends allowed[from][msg.sender] but never verifies the allowance is sufficient before moving balances, so any caller can attempt transfers and underflow is only caught by safeSub.
approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] before invoking the external callback.
transferAnyERC20Token forwards any external ERC20 balance to the owner state variable.
transfer calls safeSub to debit the sender balance.
transfer calls safeAdd to credit the recipient balance.
transferFrom calls safeSub for balances and allowance decrement.
transferFrom calls safeAdd to credit the recipient balance.
approveAndCall reaches the external receiveApproval invocation with user-supplied data.
transferAnyERC20Token reaches the external ERC20 transfer call at the caller-supplied tokenAddress.
The receiveApproval external call executes attacker-controlled code while the allowance set in approveAndCall is still live, allowing re-entry into the contract.
An attacker-controlled spender can re-enter transferFrom during the receiveApproval callback and spend the freshly granted allowance before approval bookkeeping completes.
The arbitrary ERC20 transfer call lets a malicious tokenAddress contract re-enter transferAnyERC20Token.

Parameter a is the left operand of the multiplication c = a * b in safeMul.
Parameter b is the right operand of the multiplication c = a * b in safeMul.
The multiplication result is stored into local c, which is overflow-guarded only by the require(a == 0 || c / a == b) assertion.
safeAdd produces its local result c from a + b.
safeSub produces its local result c from a - b after require(b <= a).
safeDiv produces its local result c from a / b after require(b > 0).
